exposure: Sentinel lymph node dissection (SLND) for endometrial cancer
Vaginal natural orifice transluminal endoscopic surgery (vNOTES) method
outcome: Sentinel lymph node detection rates (bilateral and symmetric)
Suitability for patients with low lung capacity
cohort: The study included 24 endometrial cancer patients who underwent sentinel lymph node dissection utilizing indocyanine green in a specific center between January 2022 and June 2024.
finding: The study found high bilateral and symmetric sentinel lymph node detection rates (96%, 94%, and 79%) using the vNOTES approach for endometrial cancer, demonstrating a safer and more comfortable surgical option with low post-operative pain scores and applicability for patients with low lung capacity.
